title: Phrack Issue 73 Released, Drawing Exploit and SSH History Discussion
summary: Phrack issue 73 is now available at phrack.org, giving security researchers and exploit developers a new issue of the long-running publication. Reader discussion highlights exploit material—one commenter refers to a Docker escape in the issue—and a historical article on the 2000 SSH1 exploit. The supplied material does not include the full issue or establish whether the Docker exploit was responsibly disclosed or assigned a CVE.
